hmm Why does nobody talk about real problems like this? I use Cowork, not Code. All 51 of my skills are my own, uploaded as .skill files, but the app labels them “plugin” skills, so Claude can’t edit them. When I asked it to improve one, it showed a “save skill” card that did nothing: no error, nothing saved. So every fix means Claude writes a new .skill file, I re-upload it by hand and replace the old one. Slow and easy to mess up.

Every video is about Claude Code, so Cowork problems get ignored. Not everyone is a developer, and some of us want Cowork. Anthropic: let Claude update my uploaded skills with my approval, or at least show a clear error instead of a card that silently fails.
